simple.meaning: רְפַס (rᵉphaç) is a Hebrew word meaning “stamp.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רְפַס (H7512) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 7:7, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְפַס (H7512) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רְפַס (H7512) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רְפַס (rᵉphaç) / H7512 is traced through Daniel 7:7, Daniel 7:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, there was a fourth animal, awesome and powerful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth. It devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet. It was different from all the animals that were before it. It had ten horns.
